title: Living in the clouds
content: Had a dream that stuck with me the other night. I lived in the clouds and I climbed a hanging rope ladder to get up there, I had an animal companion but I couldn’t really tell if it was a dog or a cat or a mix of the two. I would occasionally climb down from my cloud for special occasions.. but I’d always try to climb up higher and higher in the clouds. It was so vivid and so beautiful.
